aiOverview.content: "NRCC" most commonly refers to either the National Republican Congressional Committee, a political committee dedicated to electing Republicans to the U.S. House of Representatives, or New River Community College, a two-year public institution located in Dublin, Virginia. National Republican Congressional Committee (NRCC) Purpose: The NRCC is the primary political organization working to elect Republicans to the House of Representatives. Activity: The committee hosts annual fundraising dinners, featuring prominent Republican figures such as President Donald Trump. New River Community College (NRCC) Location: Situated in Dublin, VA, with a STEM-focused site in Christiansburg, serving the New River Valley. Academics: Offers over 40 programs, including associate degrees, certificates, and workforce training. Student Support: Provides resources for student needs, including food and transportation assistance. Cost: 2023-2024 tuition for in-state students was roughly $4,835, and for out-of-state was $10,837. Note: For the college, visit nr.edu.
